## About
Peak Collision Englewood is on S Santa Fe Dr, with sister shops in Littleton and Colorado Springs. We bring the resources of a corporate auto body shop and the personal attention of an independent one.
We take the time to listen to your needs, answer your questions, and give honest recommendations for your situation. Reviewers have named Jennifer and Mary up front, Gina on the intake team, and John in the shop.
Our mission is to keep your car on the road. That means quality repairs, good service and transparent pricing, so you can get back on the road safely and with confidence.

## Services
- Free Estimates: We look over your vehicle's damage and give you a cost projection for repairs, with no obligation.
- Insurance Assistance: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider, and document repairs to your provider's guidelines.
- Lifetime Warranty: We stand behind our workmanship for as long as you own the vehicle.
- Paintless Dent Repair: We remove minor dents and dings without touching the original paint finish.
- Cosmetic and structural vehicle repair: From surface damage to the structure underneath.
- Bumper repair
- Paint repair
- Vehicle diagnostics & calibration

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help streamline the repair process.

Q: How long will it take to repair my vehicle?
A: It depends on the extent of the damage, the repairs needed, and parts availability. We'll send you repair updates while your vehicle is with us.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: That depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing information.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is under warranty for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something isn't right, bring it back and we'll make it right.

Q: Do I have to pay for everything today?
A: No. We offer a flexible way to break up the cost of your repair over time, and checking your options won't affect your credit score.

Throughout the entire repair, John kept me updated with photos, from the removal of the truck bed to each stage of the rebuild. I never wondered how things were going or worried about surprise setbacks.

Although the original estimate was two weeks, my truck was actually finished early and exactly as promised.
